title: Kuinka with an adjective: answering about degree
focus: Kuinka before an adjective asks about degree: Kuinka vanha olet? Kuinka vanha sinä olet? — Olen kaksikymmentä vuotta vanha.
targetSkills: Kuinka with an adjective: answering about degree
prerequisiteSkills: Miten and kuinka: answering about manner

exercises.prompt: Choose the question meaning “How old are you?”  Address one person (sinä).
exercises.explanation: Singular refers to one person or one thing in these patterns. An adjective is a word that describes a quality. Kuinka before an adjective asks about degree: Kuinka vanha olet? (“How old are you?”) and Kuinka pitkä matka on? (“How long is the journey?”). Miten is possible in several such patterns; these tasks teach the neutral kuinka pattern and accept a natural miten alternative. The complete question means “How old are you”.

exercises.targetSkill: Kuinka with an adjective: answering about degree

exercises.prompt: Answer “Kuinka vanha hän on?”: choose “She is thirty years old.”
